data.one_liner: A Flutter widget to display a list of items arranged in a circle.
data.what_it_does: It arranges a list of child widgets in a circular layout. It supports customization of radii, gradients, colors, center widgets, and interactive rotation gestures.
use_when: You need to display menu items or widgets in a circular layout.
You want a rotatable list of items arranged in a circle.
avoid_when: You need standard linear or grid layouts.
You are building complex data charts.
strengths: Easy to use with a simple widget interface
Allows custom center widgets and background gradients
weaknesses: Limited to circular arrangement use cases
Documentation outside the README is minimal
